name: multi-account-gmail-mcp
description: Full mailbox access across explicitly selected Gmail accounts.

interface.shortDescription: Full Gmail access with explicit account selection.
interface.longDescription: Searches, reads, downloads attachments, organizes, forwards, drafts, sends, and deletes Gmail across configured accounts. Every operation requires an explicit account, and irreversible tools are marked destructive.
defaultPrompt: Show my unread email in one mailbox.
Download the attachments from a chosen email.
Forward a message after I review the draft.
